new_scholarship.description: The University of Otago Doctoral Scholarship is the University's main doctoral award, funding PhD and professional doctorate (DClinDent, DMA, DBA, EDd) candidates at the University of Otago in Dunedin, New Zealand. It pays a NZ$34,128 per annum stipend plus a tuition fee waiver for 36 months at the domestic rate, and excludes student services fee and insurance. Up to 153 awards are offered annually to both domestic and international applicants who are seeking their first doctoral qualification. Applications can be submitted at any time and are considered at quarterly rounds in March, June, September and November.

research_notes.logo: Read the award page markup on the awarding body's own domain (otago.ac.nz). The only wordmark asset published there is the site header lockup https://www.otago.ac.nz/__data/assets/file/0034/568366/UoO_Logo_RGB_Horz_Gold-REV.svg. Two probe attempts on that asset and on the brand-guide page both timed out, so HTTP 200 and content type could not be confirmed. The '-REV' filename suffix indicates the reversed lockup, which the University's own brand guide describes as 'White and Gold on St Andrew's Blue' (the Otago blogs asset alt text on the same domain likewise describes the names as white with a gold tohu), i.e. a white wordmark that would be invisible on a light card - a hard ban. The University's brand guide states the non-reversed, dark-on-light wordmark files are behind University staff login, and the footer's only other mark, /__data/assets/image/0028/568108/1869-emblem.png, sits on the same dark footer so its colour could not be confirmed as a dark variant either. No probed, own-domain, non-white logo asset could be produced, so logo_override is null.

new_scholarship.description: The Stefan Banach NAWA Programme is a scholarship funded by the Polish National Agency for Academic Exchange with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs as part of Polish development cooperation, for citizens of 36 countries covered by Polish Aid. It funds full-time second-cycle (Master's) studies in Polish or English at universities supervised by the Minister of Science and Higher Education, optionally preceded by a one-year NAWA preparatory course. The package is a PLN 2,500 monthly scholarship, exemption from tuition fees at public universities, a PLN 2,500 travel allowance, a funded preparatory course for the Polish track and a Polish language and culture course for the English track. The 2026 call closed on 8 May 2026 at 3:00 p.m. CEST, with results expected by 31 July 2026.
